tagline: Cruise a red convertible down a pixel-art coastal highway as the sun sinks into the sea.
description:
**Velvet Cruise** is a retro arcade driving game in pixel art. You take the wheel of a red convertible carrying two passengers along a seaside highway, with rocky cliffs on one side and the ocean, sea stacks, and a lone sailboat on the other. A big orange sun hangs low on the horizon.

The goal is right there on the title screen: *chase the sunset down the coast!* Hit **DRIVE!** to start your run, or check the **RANKINGS** to see how your times compare.

Controls are simple and keyboard-based: use the left and right arrow keys to steer, the up arrow for gas, and the down arrow to brake. Press Enter to start.
